question: What was the percentage change in the high price per share of NetApp's common stock on NASDAQ during the second quarter between fiscal 2018 and fiscal 2019?
retrieval_query: NetApp common stock high price per share percentage change NASDAQ second quarter fiscal 2018 fiscal 2019
answer:
High price per share in second quarter fiscal 2018: $45.14  
High price per share in second quarter fiscal 2019: $88.08  

Percentage change = ((88.08 - 45.14) / 45.14) × 100 = (42.94 / 45.14) × 100 ≈ 95.06%

Source: 9082b05b2e0e2600d7f405f82795f041.pdf p.1

95.06
